title: EmoLens — Facial Emotion Recognition
description: A computer-vision prototype with image, camera and video inputs, built around EfficientNet-B3 and attention-based classification.
problem: How can a trained image classifier be made accessible through an interactive application?
approach: Used EfficientNet-B3 with CBAM attention, dataset deduplication and confidence calibration, then added camera, upload and video interfaces.
outcome: An end-to-end demonstration of model integration, prediction presentation and multiple input formats.
limitations: Predicted facial-expression labels do not establish a person’s internal emotional state. This is a learning prototype, not a clinical or employment assessment tool.
